input: let's add blog posts about the development and findings and projects as part of the development goals.
follow_up_inputs: can you write up fifteen blog posts plus podcast episodes and put them on the ghp website about specific and broad things the that have been going on in the repo?
task: Owner direction: blog posts as a development goal

doc_friction.issue: docs/posts/** was not in the PR trigger paths, so a post-only PR ran no build and a malformed post (loadPosts throws) would only fail at publish on main; fixed in this PR
loadPosts throws on any non-dated .md in docs/posts/, so the folder cannot hold its own README; the format lives only in writing.mjs's header comment
SERVED_EXTENSIONS still frames every type as an nginx question (mime.types, gitops/prod/portfolio-site.yaml) though the cluster was retired 2026-10-01 and GitHub Pages serves the site
excludes research/ as a 'mirror', stale since the 2026-10-16 cutover, so research tests are never mutation-measured (found by a subagent; not fixed here)

notes: The blog already existed (writing/ section, Atom feed, 2 posts from 2026-10-16) but no goal or prompt pointed runs at it. Added goals.md 'Direction: write about the work', a CLAUDE.md bullet, writing-backlog.mjs (research tracks with no post; 0 of 222 covered before this run), and two research roundup posts (house: 35 projects, simdesign: 58) drafted by subagents; I spot-checked 32 numbers against their READMEs and all matched. Follow-up (PR 8711): 15 posts + 15 episode scripts drafted by five subagents from a shared brief; I spot-checked ~60 numbers against READMEs and tool output (redteam.py tally, runcost.py report), all matched. Built a podcast (podcast.mjs, podcast_tts.py: Piper en_US-ljspeech-high, public-domain data; 87.5 min, 26 MB MP3 committed; RSS feed). Ported three main breakages from other merges: xero VENTURE.yaml evidence + FAQ drift (#8671), front-door mirror regen, nine byok.mjs copies drifted by #8623.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: 15 researched posts (~1,200 words each) + 15 audio scripts, a podcast feature with tests, recording ~90 min of narration, and three ported CI fixes

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
